documentation.content: Check the Research queue and Scheduler state, the controller, and the SQL outbox. Check for a planned queue pause before escalating.

conditions.displayName: Tokyo Research queue depth above zero for ten minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "cloudtasks.googleapis.com/queue/depth" AND resource.type = "cloud_tasks_queue" AND resource.labels.project_id = "ocean-v1-beta-20261101" AND resource.labels.location = "asia-northeast1" AND resource.labels.queue_id = "ocean-v1-beta-research"

displayName: OCEAN Beta | Private Research delivery failure

documentation.content: Check the private controller and canonical Cloud Tasks delivery. Reconcile the current SQL head and outbox before taking recovery action.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: logName="projects/ocean-v1-beta-20261101/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="ocean-v1-beta-20261101" AND resource.labels.location="asia-northeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name="ocean-v1-beta-research-controller" AND httpRequest.requestMethod="POST" AND httpRequest.requestUrl=~"/internal/research/(dispatch|run|answer)$" AND httpRequest.status>=500 AND httpRequest.status<600

displayName: OCEAN Beta | Automated SQL backup window failed or skipped

documentation.content: Check the reported backup window and the age of the most recent successful backup. Use the approved isolated restore procedure to verify recovery.

conditions.displayName: Beta Cloud SQL automated backup failed or skipped

conditionMatchedLog.filter: logName="projects/ocean-v1-beta-20261101/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fsystem_event" AND resource.type="cloudsql_database" AND resource.labels.project_id="ocean-v1-beta-20261101" AND resource.labels.region="ASIA_NORTHEAST1" AND protoPayload.methodName="cloudsql.instances.automatedBackup" AND protoPayload.resourceName="projects/ocean-v1-beta-20261101/instances/ocean-v1-beta-sql" AND (protoPayload.metadata.windowStatus="STATUS_FAILED" OR protoPayload.metadata.windowStatus="STATUS_SKIPPED")
